rows.ARS:
Apricot or apricot blend Shrub.
Registration name: HARforum
rows.Origin:
Bred by Harkness & Co. (United Kingdom, 1998).
Introduced in United Kingdom by R Harkness & Co. Ltd. in 1999 as 'Picture of Health'.
rows.Bloom: Apricot or apricot blend. Flowers blush white with pale apricot center. Mild, lemon fragrance. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Named to celebrate the 50th Anniversary of the National (UK) Health Service.

colour: Apricot or apricot blend. Flowers blush white with pale apricot center.
